changeSet.author: sDooley
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionGroup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionGroup]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [GroupUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](2500) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [PrimaryOwnerUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [SecondaryOwnerUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionGroup] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END

changeSet.author: sdooley
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionGroup' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ExecutionItemUid') begin alter table api.ExecutionGroup add [ExecutionItemUid] uniqueidentifier end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionGroup' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ExecutionItemUid') begin alter table api.ExecutionGroup drop column [ExecutionItemUid] end

changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionGroup' and COLUMN_NAME = 'IsActiveDirectoryGroup') begin alter table api.ExecutionGroup add [IsActiveDirectoryGroup] bit end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionGroup' and COLUMN_NAME = 'IsActiveDirectoryGroup') begin alter table api.ExecutionGroup drop column [IsActiveDirectoryGroup] end

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: If Exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionGroup' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ExecutionItemUid') BEGIN IF Not EXISTS (select 1 from [sys].[indexes] i where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionGroup_ExecutionIDExecutionItemUid' and object_id = object_id(N'api.ExecutionGroup')) BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionGroup_ExecutionIDExecutionItemUid] ON [api].[ExecutionGroup] ([ExecutionID] ASC, [ExecutionItemUid] ASC) END END
changeSet.rollback: If Exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionGroup' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ExecutionItemUid') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select 1 from [sys].[indexes] i where name = 'IX_ApiExecutionGroup_ExecutionIDExecutionItemUid' and object_id = object_id(N'api.ExecutionGroup')) BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_ApiExecutionGroup_ExecutionIDExecutionItemUid] ON [api].[ExecutionGroup] END END
